name: fix-collaborative-prompts
goal: Rewrite the /plan-collaborative DAG node prompts and HeadWrench system prompt so the planning agent clearly understands it is designing a session artifact — not conducting the collaborative work itself.

subtasks.name: update-headwrench-collaborative-description
subtasks.description: Rewrite the 'Collaborative' one-liner in the Plan Types section of opencode/agents/headwrench.md to explicitly state the planning agent designs a session artifact, not collaborative output.

subtasks.name: rewrite-idea-intake
subtasks.description: Rewrite opencode/planning/plan-collaborative/prompts/idea-intake.md with a prominent role-boundary statement: the planning agent is session designer not session participant; intake confirms the topic to design around, does not begin exploring it.

subtasks.name: rewrite-clarify
subtasks.description: Rewrite opencode/planning/plan-collaborative/prompts/clarify.md to reframe: questions serve the designer's need to structure an effective session, not the session's own exploratory questions. Agent gathers context to design well, not to answer the topic.

subtasks.name: rewrite-seed-gate
subtasks.description: Rewrite opencode/planning/plan-collaborative/prompts/seed-gate.md to make explicit: presenting a session design artifact for approval; gate asks 'is this a good session design?' not 'is this a good answer to the topic?'

subtasks.name: rewrite-finalize
subtasks.description: Rewrite opencode/planning/plan-collaborative/prompts/finalize.md with explicit constraints: the agent is a file writer only; the spec stub contains only what the user provided plus surfaced open questions — no agent-generated design content. Must prevent the failure mode where the agent writes design proposals, 6-pillar redesigns, or any collaborative output in the session artifact.

subtasks.name: update-agent-routing
subtasks.description: Update opencode/planning/plan-collaborative/prompts/agent-routing.md to align role language with the session-designer framing established in the other rewrites.
